slots.jd.charter-network.about:
Summary
Brookside Community Schools is a nonprofit charter school network committed to giving every child a strong start in reading, learning and community life. The Associate Teacher works alongside a lead teacher to deliver daily instruction, keep classrooms orderly and welcoming, and stay in close contact with families. A current State Teaching Licence is required for this position.
slots.jd.charter-network.duties:
Duties
- Plan daily lessons with the lead teacher and prepare materials ahead of each school day
- Establish and maintain classroom routines that keep students focused and transitions smooth
- Lead small-group instruction and support whole-class lessons as assigned
- Prepare for and take part in parent conferences, sharing student progress and next steps
- Monitor student understanding and adjust activities to meet individual needs
- Keep accurate records of attendance, behavior and student work
slots.jd.charter-network.needs:
Licensure and qualifications
- State Teaching Licence required
- 2 or more years of classroom experience in an elementary setting
- Lesson planning and phonics instruction for early readers
- Classroom management and behavior supports that build positive routines
- Parent communication skills, including regular updates through Seesaw
- Reading Specialist Endorsement preferred
slots.r1.b1: Plan daily classroom routines through lesson planning with the lead teacher, cutting transition time between activities by 50 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Track student progress with ClassDojo, recording daily behavior and participation notes to share with the lead teacher and families.
slots.r1.b3: Coordinate behavior supports with grade-level colleagues during team planning, reducing classroom referrals by 30 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Adapt lessons for different learners in Nearpod, adding visual prompts and paced activities for students who need extra support.
slots.r1.i1: Supports the lead teacher in an elementary classroom at Oakridge Charter School, building and maintaining the daily routines that keep students on task.
slots.r1.i2: Assists with assessing student progress at Oakridge Charter School, gathering classroom evidence to guide instruction under the direction of a lead teacher.
slots.summary.1: Entry-level elementary teacher with about 2 years of experience supporting a lead teacher on a small share of classroom instruction. Uses Google Classroom, formative assessment and Nearpod to deliver lessons and check student understanding.
slots.summary.2: Elementary teaching professional at the entry level, with about 2 years of experience working under close supervision on assigned lessons and small groups. Brings working knowledge of formative assessment, Google Classroom and Nearpod, along with a B.A. in Elementary Education and a State Teaching Licence.
